title: Runs fold main as main moves, not only at start and land
description: hn6 (2026-10-05/06) twice failed to land because main moved a lot under a long-lived epic branch (dozens of agent PRs touching watch.go, the contracts bundle, CI scripts) and the land fold conflicted in a dozen files at once; it took a hand merge to recover. Fold main into the integration branch periodically during a run (e.g. after each wave or when main gains N commits) so conflicts stay small and are resolved while the context is fresh.
acceptance_criteria: A run folds main when main has moved (bounded cadence) and resolves small conflicts through the existing resolve path; tests.
